## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/four-month-content.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
py -3 -B docs/validate_authoring.py docs/AFRICAN_MANDATE_STAGE2_PACKAGE3_FOUR_MONTH_GAMEPLAY_SPEC_v0_1.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 8/8, full CI reports 133/133 plus deterministic/fixture/boundary/schema passes, governance reports 7/7, the authoring validator reports 18 actions and three decisions per month, the compiled hash matches the pinned value, and Prompt 18 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata.
